description: Look up one Australian manufacturer by its 11-digit ABN, typically obtained from search_manufacturers. Returns description, industry, ANZSIC classification, company size, website, tags and general locations. No API key required. Excludes phone, email and street addresses; use the Business-plan get_contact_details tool for those. Returns an error if no matching manufacturer exists. Directory verification does not establish product-specific capability or certification.
name: get_manufacturer_profile
title: Get a manufacturer profile
